description: Traffic Volume Survey is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Casey. This GIS dataset contains traffic survey findings within the City of Casey. Information collected includes survey point locations, traffic volume counts, 85 th percentile average speeds measurements, commercial vehicle proportions, and peak period usage levels. Coverage: City of Casey. The portal files it under the publisher City of Casey. Its tags are roads, traffic, transport. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
